bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring the attorney general to reimburse legal costs of Mille Lacs County; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+COUNTY REIMBURSEMENT. +]

[+The attorney general must reimburse Mille Lacs County $7,800,000 for litigation costs incurred prior to 2024 to defend the lawsuit, Mille Lacs Band of Ojibwe, et al. v. County of Mille Lacs, Minnesota, et al., Case No. 17-CV-05155, and all appeals from that suit. The payment must be made by June 30, 2026. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the attorney general to make the payment required in section 1. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring the attorney general to reimburse legal costs of Mille Lacs County; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. COUNTY REIMBURSEMENT.

The attorney general must reimburse Mille Lacs County $7,800,000 for litigation costs incurred prior to 2024 to defend the lawsuit, Mille Lacs Band of Ojibwe, et al. v. County of Mille Lacs, Minnesota, et al., Case No. 17-CV-05155, and all appeals from that suit. The payment must be made by June 30, 2026.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the attorney general to make the payment required in section 1.
additions: The attorney general must reimburse Mille Lacs County $7,800,000 for litigation costs incurred prior to 2024 to defend the lawsuit, Mille Lacs Band of Ojibwe, et al. v. County of Mille Lacs, Minnesota, et al., Case No. 17-CV-05155, and all appeals from that suit. The payment must be made by June 30, 2026.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the attorney general to make the payment required in section 1.
